wins.label: Strong Q1 operational sales growth
wins.evidence: We delivered operational sales growth of 6.4%. Excluding STELARA, Johnson & Johnson grew double digits for the quarter.

wins.label: ICOTYDE successful launch
wins.evidence: ICOTYDE is the first and only IL-23 targeted oral peptide...1,500 patients already that prescriptions have been written for...already over 1,000 unique customers that are writing

wins.label: TREMFYA strong momentum
wins.evidence: TREMFYA delivered impressive growth of 63.8%. Our IBD launch is driving significant momentum, and we continue to see share gains across all indications

wins.label: DARZALEX market leadership
wins.evidence: DARZALEX remains the gold standard in multiple myeloma and our #1 product with sales of $4 billion and operational sales growth of 18%

wins.label: Path to double-digit growth
wins.evidence: We are confident our progress will continue to improve into 2027 with line of sight to double-digit growth by the end of the decade...we are already delivering double-digit growth as total Johnson & Johnson when you exclude the STELARA

risks.label: STELARA biosimilar headwind
risks.evidence: Sales increased 6.4% despite an approximate 540 basis point headwind from STELARA...STELARA declined 61.7% driven by share loss due to biosimilar competition

risks.label: Margin compression
risks.evidence: Innovative Medicine margin declined from 42.5% to 39.7%...MedTech margin declined from 25.9% to 22.3% primarily driven by the impact of tariffs

risks.label: Tariff impact on MedTech
risks.evidence: Cost of goods sold deleveraged by 10 basis points, driven by the impact of tariffs and other operational drivers in the MedTech business

risks.label: China VBP headwinds
risks.evidence: We do anticipate some second half impact from volume-based procurement in China for electrophysiology products

risks.label: Increasing IVL competition
risks.evidence: The IVL market...clearly, competition is coming. Competition is going to come to any space that is attractive
